zoe (eng-platform): Noticed EU recompute backlog jumped to ~19k after last ingest flood. Thinking of a short-lived urgency path to handle top hot tenants.
omar (eng-sre): Worker CPU spiking when we push concurrency. Preemption noise is up.
li (eng-runtime): I can map an `urgency` flag to preferring preemptible-dedicated pool. Need fallback route and lease guard.
maya (product): UX: console needs strong friction for ‘urgent’ (confirm, show affected customers).
sam (eng-platform): Proposal: dry-run preview -> fractional 0.2 top slices -> canary urgent for 30m with quota bump + abort criteria.
replay-bot: dry-run ready  total=18,974; top-20%=3,795; est tokens=5.0M; est runtime~50m @ concurrency=70.
omar (eng-sre): Safety: max_lease=240s, abort if error-rate>0.8% or live-p50 rises >10%.
li (eng-runtime): I'll add routing + fallback to best-effort with halved concurrency. ETA 35m.
sam (eng-platform): I'll add preflight API preview and simple modal listing top 20 tenants and cost. ETA 90m.
maya (product): Approve with checklist: notify stakeholders if run >20m.
zoe (eng-platform): OK, schedule canary in +25m. Post status here and in #oncall.
